Magnetic space groups#

All 1651 magnetic space groups: symmetry operations and Wyckoff sites. Only the standard setting of the BNS description is given for each magnetic space group.

ID “a.b” is the BNS number:

  • a: number of the space group.

  • b: serial number in each crystal family, starting from 1 in triclinic, monoclinic, orthorhombic, tetragonal, trigonal and hexagonal, and cubic groups.

The BNS and OG columns are the Belov-Neronova-Smirnova and Opechowski-Guccione symbols. Type: I (ordinary), II (gray), III (black-white, some operations combined with the time reversal), IV (black-white, the time reversal combined with a translation).
